steps.headline: 1. Ask before YouCoded downloads files from this folder.
steps.changed: An inline folder question offers Allow downloads and Not now.
steps.notice: Local previews remain usable. Permission does not download the whole folder.
steps.risk: Fake backend: no protection yet; Windows unverified; duration needs your answer.

steps.headline: 2. Declining leaves local files usable and makes changing your choice explicit.
steps.changed: Local files only explains what remains usable, with Change download permission to reopen the question.
steps.notice: Files with unknown availability stay distinct from files known to be online-only; neither previews automatically.
steps.risk: Availability and provider names are simulated facts here; no production reads are protected yet.

steps.path: Allow downloads → select an online-only file
steps.headline: 3. Explain which file is waiting without blocking the rest of YouCoded.
steps.changed: A quiet waiting notice names OneDrive only when the provider is known; otherwise it says Waiting for the file.
steps.notice: No made-up percentage or cancellation promise. The proposed next step is to open the selected file here when ready.
steps.risk: Waiting and continuation are simulated: nothing finishes downloading or opens automatically in this prototype; the continuation question below needs an explicit answer.

steps.path: New Conversation → allow downloading required instructions
steps.headline: 4. Explain why a new conversation is waiting for its project instructions.
steps.changed: The notice says project instructions file instead of native assistant startup, and explains that other work can continue.
steps.notice: The proposed next step is to start the conversation once YouCoded can read its instructions, not silently omit them.
steps.risk: The New Conversation button only simulates this native-chat case; no real startup or continuation is implemented, and external programs remain unrestricted.

steps.headline: Should folder permission last until you close YouCoded?
steps.today: You chose folder permission for the current session, but Projects can be open without a conversation.
steps.problem: Session could mean one conversation or the whole time YouCoded is open; the app should not guess silently.
steps.proposal: The pictures propose one folder grant shared across conversations until YouCoded closes. Choose that lifetime or ask for a conversation-only design.

options.label: Until YouCoded closes
pros: No repeat prompt when changing conversations in this folder.
cons: Permission remains available to YouCoded throughout this app run.

options.label: One conversation only
cons: Projects browsing without a conversation needs a separate rule and design.

steps.risk: The app-run duration is proposed, not an interpretation already approved by your earlier session answer.

steps.headline: Should the selected action continue automatically when its file becomes ready?
steps.today: The prototype now explains a next step, but its waiting state never completes an actual operation.
steps.problem: Without a next-step rule, you cannot tell whether to wait or click the file or New Conversation again.
steps.proposal: Continue only the action you selected: open that file in Projects, or start that native conversation when its instructions are ready.

options.label: Continue automatically
pros: You do not need to repeat the action.
cons: It may become ready after you have moved on to other work.

options.label: Ask when ready
pros: You choose when to open the file or start the conversation.
cons: Requires another click after the wait.

steps.risk: Automatic continuation is only proposed copy in these pictures; answering this question establishes whether it should be built.

steps.headline: Confirm: protect YouCoded’s own reads, without restricting external programs?
steps.today: You corrected the earlier external-tools question: you want YouCoded itself to stop downloading and freezing without explanation.
steps.problem: That earlier submitted question recorded confusion, not approval for restrictions on Claude Code, shell commands, Git or MCP tools.
steps.proposal: Keep your correction: consent and responsive waiting for YouCoded-owned reads, including its context display for Claude Code conversations; no external-tool gates or wrappers.

options.label: YouCoded reads only
pros: Addresses the app’s own previews, instructions and file operations.
cons: Independent external programs may still download files on their own.

steps.risk: This confirmation records your corrected scope; it does not reinterpret the original confused answer as consent.

steps.path: A selected file or conversation is still waiting
steps.headline: Should you be able to abandon the pending action?
steps.today: You can leave Projects and keep working while a selected action waits; there is no abandon-request button in this proposal.
steps.problem: You may change your mind before the file is ready, especially if automatic continuation is chosen.
steps.proposal: Consider a separate Stop waiting action that abandons YouCoded’s pending open or startup, without claiming to stop OneDrive’s download.

options.label: Design stop waiting
pros: Prevents an unwanted pending action from continuing.
cons: Needs separate behavior design; a provider download may continue anyway.

options.label: Defer this control
pros: Keeps this first design focused on permission and explanation.
cons: No explicit way to abandon the pending action yet.

steps.risk: No abandon or cancellation behavior has been implemented; neither option promises that OneDrive will stop downloading.
